gloss: a little while ago; a bit earlier; just before

definitions.gloss: a little while ago; a bit earlier; just before
definitions.explanation: Refers to a short time before the present or before some specified moment. Can describe minutes, hours, days, or weeks earlier depending on context.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: He went home a little while ago.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}っていた→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: Until a little while ago, I was in touch with her.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|へん}→辺：00937_hen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently there was a big accident around here a little while ago.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ (a little) + ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (before, ago). The amount of time is left vague — context determines whether "a little" means minutes or months.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: a little while ago (most common)
- {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until a little while ago
- ⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{少|すこ}し{前|まえ}: just a moment ago (emphasized)
- {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: a recent story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧: a little while ago — casual, usually means very recently (minutes)
- ⟦{先程|さきほど}→先程：04165_sakihodo⟧: a moment ago (polite) — formal equivalent of ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: a bit ago — synonymous and interchangeable
- ⟦この{間|あいだ}→この間：01257_konoaida⟧: the other day — usually days or weeks ago
